report.readme_md:
# Kimi-K3 on Token Factory: Partial Conformance, Fast but Limited

Generated by Nebius Integration Scout · 2026-11-02 · endpoint https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/

**Verdict:** integration verified · recommended model `moonshotai/Kimi-K3` · workload integration · no latency budget given

## What was proven
- PydanticAI on daytona: tool call verified — PydanticAI probe succeeded: typed tool call and typed output round-trip completed

Conformance kit: 8 pass · 0 partial · 5 fail (chat.basic=FAIL, tools.choice_required=FAIL, tools.choice_named=FAIL, structured.json_schema=FAIL, streaming.text=FAIL)

## Measured on your prompt
| model | TTFT ms | tokens/s | prefix-cache hit (tokens) |
|---|---|---|---|
| moonshotai/Kimi-K3 | 2996.6 | 75.0 | 64 |
| Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 | 53669.3 | 46.1 | 224 |

## Findings
- Kimi-K3 fails chat.basic: returns empty content in plain chat mode.
- Tool calling works but named and required choices are broken (2 FAILs).
- JSON schema output is not supported (structured.json_schema=FAIL).
- Text streaming is broken: no content chunks emitted (streaming.text=FAIL).
- Kimi-K3 is 18x faster in TTFT (3s vs 54s) and 63% faster in decode vs Qwen3-235B.
- Prefix cache works: 64 tokens cached on second run.

## Next steps
- Use Kimi-K3 for fast tool-using agents but avoid required/named tool choice.
- Do not rely on JSON schema or text streaming; use tool-mode for structured output.
- Switch to Qwen3-235B if full conformance is required.
- File a ticket for Kimi-K3 chat and streaming fixes.

## Cost
add prices to pricing.json for an estimate

    provider=OpenAIProvider(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/", api_key=NEBIUS_API_KEY),
)
agent = Agent(model, output_type=YourOutput, instructions="...")

@agent.tool_plain
def your_tool(arg: str) -> dict:

    ...

result = await agent.run("...")   # tool calls, validation and typed output handled by PydanticAI
```

# Kimi-K3 on Token Factory: Partial Conformance, Fast but Limited

Generated by Nebius Integration Scout · 2026-11-02 · endpoint https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/

**Verdict:** integration verified · recommended model `moonshotai/Kimi-K3` · workload integration · no latency budget given

## What was proven
- PydanticAI on daytona: tool call verified — PydanticAI probe succeeded: typed tool call and typed output round-trip completed

Conformance kit: 8 pass · 0 partial · 5 fail (chat.basic=FAIL, tools.choice_required=FAIL, tools.choice_named=FAIL, structured.json_schema=FAIL, streaming.text=FAIL)

## Measured on your prompt
| model | TTFT ms | tokens/s | prefix-cache hit (tokens) |
|---|---|---|---|
| moonshotai/Kimi-K3 | 2996.6 | 75.0 | 64 |
| Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 | 53669.3 | 46.1 | 224 |

## Findings
- Kimi-K3 fails chat.basic: returns empty content in plain chat mode.
- Tool calling works but named and required choices are broken (2 FAILs).
- JSON schema output is not supported (structured.json_schema=FAIL).
- Text streaming is broken: no content chunks emitted (streaming.text=FAIL).
- Kimi-K3 is 18x faster in TTFT (3s vs 54s) and 63% faster in decode vs Qwen3-235B.
- Prefix cache works: 64 tokens cached on second run.

## Next steps
- Use Kimi-K3 for fast tool-using agents but avoid required/named tool choice.
- Do not rely on JSON schema or text streaming; use tool-mode for structured output.
- Switch to Qwen3-235B if full conformance is required.
- File a ticket for Kimi-K3 chat and streaming fixes.
